name: Galadriel
description: Commander of the Northern Armies, who has hunted Sauron for centuries and will not believe the war is over.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Elrond
description: Half-elven herald of the High King: a politician and a poet, and an old friend of both Galadriel and Durin.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Gil-galad
description: High King of the Elves, ruling from Lindon.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Círdan
description: The Shipwright, lord of the Grey Havens and eldest of the Elves in Middle-earth.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Celebrimbor
description: Lord of Eregion and the greatest Elven-smith of the age.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Mirdania
description: A gifted smith of Eregion and Celebrimbor's apprentice.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Arondir
description: A Silvan Elf soldier posted to watch the Southlands, in love with the healer Bronwyn.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Bronwyn
description: Healer of Tirharad and mother of Theo.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Theo
description: Bronwyn's son, who has found something he should not have.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Waldreg
description: The tavern-keeper of Tirharad, whose family remembers the old days.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Estrid
description: A Southlander who survived the making of Mordor.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Halbrand
description: A castaway from the Southlands with a past he would rather forget.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

reveals.name: Sauron
reveals.description: The Dark Lord, Morgoth's greatest servant. 'Halbrand, king of the Southlands' was a mask.

reveals.name: Sauron (as Annatar)

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

reveals.description: The Dark Lord, now in a fair Elvish form as Annatar, 'Lord of Gifts', a supposed emissary of the Valar at Celebrimbor's side.

name: Adar
description: A scarred Elf whom the Orcs call 'father'.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com
The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Durin IV
description: Prince of Khazad-dûm and Elrond's hot-headed old friend.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Disa
description: Durin's wife, a stone-singer who can hear the mountain.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Durin III
description: King of Khazad-dûm, wary of Elves and of digging too deep.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Míriel
description: Queen Regent of Númenor, ruling for her ailing father and haunted by a vision.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Elendil
description: A sea-captain of noble line whose name means Elf-friend.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Isildur
description: Elendil's restless son, a sailor who wants something more.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Eärien
description: Elendil's daughter, an apprentice of the Builders' Guild.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Pharazôn
description: The Queen Regent's cousin and chancellor, beloved by the people of Númenor.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

reveals.name: Ar-Pharazôn
reveals.description: King of Númenor, having taken the sceptre from his cousin Míriel.

name: Kemen
description: Pharazôn's ambitious son.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Valandil
description: Isildur's loyal friend from the Sea Guard.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Nori Brandyfoot
description: A curious young Harfoot who keeps straying off the trail.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Poppy Proudfellow
description: Nori's cautious and loyal best friend.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: Sadoc Burrows
description: Trail-finder of the Harfoots and keeper of their star-book.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: The Stranger
description: A giant of a man who fell from the sky in a ball of fire, remembering nothing.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

reveals.name: Gandalf

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

reveals.description: One of the Istari, the wizards sent to Middle-earth to oppose Sauron. The halflings called him Grand-Elf; he will be known as Gandalf.

name: Tom Bombadil
description: A merry, ancient fellow who keeps a house in the desert and calls himself Eldest.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

name: The Dark Wizard
description: A sorcerer who rules in Rhûn from the fortress of Caras Gaer.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com
